lines: - Reporters receive them via and . For Playwright API steps, the subtitle is the locator or the navigation url — for example, with subtitle . Both are rendered next to the step title in the trace viewer and the HTML report.
- 🖼️ Aria and screen snapshots in traces
- The option of and the fixture option now accept an object selecting what to capture on every action:
- With aria and screen snapshots recorded, the new mode in the trace viewer shows the action screenshot side by side with the aria snapshot, and hovering an aria node highlights it on the screenshot.
- httpCredentials now also accepts an array of credentials. The first entry matching the request origin is used, and entries without an origin match any request.
- New option includes the in the storage state, so it can be persisted and restored into later contexts.
